title: German-Style Norwegian Lamb Kebabs
description: A delicious and flavorful kebab dish made with Norwegian lamb, inspired by traditional German cuisine.
instructions: Cut the lamb shoulder into 1.5 inch cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the German-style seasoning mix, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread the lamb cubes, red bell pepper, zucchini, and red onion onto skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil (high).
Broil for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
